slides.headline: UPDATE: A nor'easter brings rain, wind and coastal flooding
slides.body: Heavy rain and wind battered the Northeast this weekend, with coastal flooding affecting shore communities along the East Coast.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons storm clouds Atlantic Ocean East Coast
photo.prompt: dark storm clouds over the Atlantic near the U.S. East Coast with rough surf and rain bands offshore

slides.headline: That put New York and New Jersey under emergencies
slides.body: New York and New Jersey declared states of emergency and told people to avoid travel through the weekend.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons New York City rain storm street flooding
photo.prompt: rain-soaked New York City street during a coastal storm with standing water and emergency lights in the distance

slides.headline: And Atlantic City saw its highest flooding since Sandy
slides.body: Flooding in Atlantic City reached its highest point since Superstorm Sandy, and neighborhoods along the Jersey Shore flooded.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons Atlantic City flooding storm surge
photo.prompt: flooded street near the Atlantic City shoreline during a coastal storm with water covering the roadway

slides.headline: That sent rescuers to flooded New Jersey motels
slides.body: First responders rescued 9 adults and 1 dog from flooded motels in New Jersey on Saturday morning.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons New Jersey coastal flooding motel street
photo.prompt: floodwater surrounding low-rise motels near the New Jersey shore during a nor'easter

slides.headline: And tens of thousands lost power across the region
slides.body: Tens of thousands of people in the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic lost power, and trees came down in New York City.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons downed tree New York City storm
photo.prompt: downed tree on a New York City street after a storm with wet pavement and crews nearby

slides.headline: So Sunday brings another round of flood risk
slides.body: The National Weather Service said the storm would intensify again Saturday night into Sunday, with more flooding likely.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons waves crashing over seawall storm
photo.prompt: large waves crashing over a seawall during a coastal storm with gray sky and spray over the road
